bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls for regulated insurers adopting analytics and ML, establishing governance patterns that let security-conscious customers deploy production AI workloads with confidence.
Established a shared-responsibility operating framework clarifying AWS versus insurer-owned control boundaries to de-risk regulated cloud adoption.
Led AWS modernization execution for monolithic policy administration and insurance platform workloads, driving legacy systems toward cloud-native architecture.
